title: Privacy and Account Safety
description: CAT 100 textbook section on privacy and account safety, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Create a unique, strong passphrase and stop reusing one password across sites.
Turn on two-factor authentication and explain why a stolen password alone then fails.
Spot the standard signals of a phishing message and respond without clicking.
Strip personal and others' data out of any text before pasting it into an AI tool.
